caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair or bench viewed from the front. It is colored in shades of brown, with darker brown tones accentuating the grain and shadow areas. The backrest and top panel are adorned with decorative cut-out patterns resembling stylized shapes or leaves. The chair's legs are straight and its joints and edges are clearly defined, with the construction and separated wooden panels visible. The lower front panel is plain, and the upper back panel is more detailed with the two cut-out patterns. The drawing is centered on a light, off-white background with minimal shading around the object. There is a handwritten signature or name, "Juanita Janiz," in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bed
